_comment: DEMO only — consent text versions, crisis phones and the metrics small-cell threshold for a fresh start. A real deployment must set BIRGE_CONSENT_VERSIONS and BIRGE_CRISIS_PHONES; it then gets k = 5 unless BIRGE_ANALYTICS_K says otherwise. analytics_k = 1 shows demo numbers that a real pilot must never show (ADR-0024). Questionnaire thresholds stay in questionnaire.json (psychologist).
